guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - North Shropshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Historic build progress, descoping and replacement contracts do not prove current orderability for a selected parcel.

facts.detail: The North Shropshire page was published on 10 May 2023.
It was last updated on 14 April 2026.
Freedom Fibre received the contract in November 2023.
The original contract targeted 12,000 premises.
Freedom Fibre had completed build to 2,500 premises.
The supplier aimed to reach a further 1,000 premises by the end of June 2025.
The remaining 8,500 premises were descoped.
External market changes prevented completion of the full contract.
BDUK began arranging alternative supplier plans.
In April 2026, premises were moved into Openreach call-off three.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cheshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Contract termination and replacement awards are planned delivery evidence, not current selected-parcel coverage.

facts.detail: The Cheshire page was published on 23 May 2024.
It was last updated on 27 February 2026.
Freedom Fibre is no longer delivering the original contract.
BDUK and Freedom Fibre mutually agreed to terminate it.
Freedom Fibre received no public funding for the terminated contract.
BDUK moved to alternative supplier plans.
BDUK agreed a replacement contract change with Openreach.
The replacement is Project Gigabit call-off eight.
Openreach was awarded £37.5 million.
The replacement contract targets around 18,500 hard-to-reach premises.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - Derbyshire Peak District
guard_streams.write_limit: Terminated and replacement contract scope is procurement evidence and cannot verify present service for selected parcels.

facts.detail: The Peak District page was published on 10 April 2024.
It was last updated on 10 April 2026.
FullFibre is no longer delivering the original contract.
BDUK and FullFibre mutually agreed to terminate the contract.
BDUK began arranging alternative delivery with other suppliers.
A replacement arrangement was agreed in April 2026.
Openreach is the replacement supplier route.
The area was added to Project Gigabit call-off one.
Call-off one already covers parts of Staffordshire.
The April 2026 contract update was added to the page.
